head: 9 new lifestyle apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These lifestyle apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Lifestyle charts this week, from a retro fridge wallpaper to a phone lock for nights out.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store paid Lifestyle chart this week
means: If you're after something new for home, pets or your routine, these are small apps people in the US are paying for right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, any in-app purchases and what it needs before you buy. The Laika App's health answers don't replace a vet.

list.name: DuoFridge
list.what: Turns your iPhone into a retro fridge wallpaper you decorate with magnets and your own photos.

list.name: murmur daily
list.what: Asks how you feel each morning, then sends three short messages for that mood through the day.

list.name: Ears Up: Dog Whistle & Clicker
list.what: A dog clicker, an adjustable dog whistle and attention sounds like a squeaky toy in one app.

list.name: FindMyItaly
list.what: Compares Italian towns by healthcare, cost, transport, climate and safety for people thinking of moving there.

list.name: Loud Alarm Clock: Actually Up
list.what: An alarm clock that only stops once you've stood up and walked, counted by your Apple Watch or phone.

list.name: The Laika App
list.what: Answers questions about your dog's health based on its breed, age and weight, and keeps vet records in one place.

list.name: PCS Destination Guide
list.what: A relocation guide for US military families moving to a new base, covering more than 215 installations.

list.name: Sell My Room
list.what: Turns photos of household items into organized listings you can prepare for Facebook Marketplace.

list.name: Drunk Proof
list.what: Locks everything except the apps and contacts you chose until the morning, for a night out.
